criticalMatterNote: Port State Control Action 17ac (rectify prior to departure). Class society occasional survey (remote) completed 26 Jan 2026; vessel cleared port but missed original departure time.

deficiencies.description: Fuel tank shut-off valve could not be operated from outside of emergency generator space (oil fuel pipes / SOLAS II-2 4.2.2.3.4).
deficiencies.cr5Contingency: Continue repairing the emergency generator F.O tank shut-off valve. Replaced/installed the spare onboard. Tested many times to confirm that the emergency shut-off valve is in good condition.
deficiencies.cr5RootCause: During the test ordered by the port state control authority, the emergency generator F.O tank shut-off valve failed and broke during operation by the crew.
deficiencies.cr6Correction: Replaced/installed the spare onboard. Tested many times to confirm that the emergency shut-off valve is in good condition. Confirmed operating in good condition.

reviewAlerts.message: Cause describes valve failure during PSC test but does not explain why remote operation was not verified before PSC or why the spare/onboard condition was not confirmed under SMS maintenance.
CR-6 proposes changing annual inspection to quarterly but lacks responsible rank, record format, and master verification after change.

reviewQuestions: When was the emergency generator F.O tank shut-off valve last tested from the remote position outside the space?
Why did the valve fail during the PSC-ordered test rather than during routine onboard inspection?
Was the spare valve onboard and serviceable before PSC; if yes, why was it not installed proactively?
Who will own the new quarterly inspection, and which checklist/log will record each test?
After replacement, were all similar remote-operated fuel shut-off valves on board checked?
